facts.text: Cooperative education is integrated into most RIT programs with alternating semesters of study and full-time paid work, with zero tuition charged during co-op terms.

sources.title: Cooperative Education and Internships | RIT
sources.quote: At RIT, co-op is built into most programs. You'll alternate blocks of co-op with semesters of on-campus study.

facts.text: Students pay no university tuition or fees while working on co-op assignments.

sources.title: Cooperative Education and Internships | RIT
sources.quote: You won't be charged fees or tuition for your co-ops or internships, because we believe you should be able to focus on developing your skills
